title: Source document index
purpose: Deduplicated index of public source URLs referenced by canonical Track 3 evidence, fresh public-web enrichment, source stack, and source manifest.

semantics.url_only: Presence in this index means the URL is referenced by retained evidence metadata; it does not mean the document bytes are archived.
semantics.source_independence: Multiple URLs do not automatically establish methodological independence.
semantics.dates: latest_capture is a repository capture date when available, not necessarily the publisher publication date.
